blind.summary: The build is B04, the six-car grid. In game.ts, RACE, RETRY, RESTART RACE and NEXT RACE now pass carCount 6. startRace still defaults to 2 cars, as the spec asks. Each AI car gets its own seeded bot, and the cached scene is now keyed on track plus driver count. The HUD and minimap get their colours and labels from the driver list. Grid slots from index 4 on follow the centreline in narrower columns so they stay on dirt and clear of props; G3 replays still match main. The results screen was reorganised to be closer to the S5 mockup (stripe across the full width, buttons under the table) so six rows fit at 844×390, and the podium screenshot confirms they do. The tests go through the public game and DOM seams. They cover every AC: RACE gives 6 cars, the grid holds on all tracks for seeds 1–20 and clears props, POS reads 1/6, the minimap shows six dots with red drawn last, the AI cars move off the grid, all six racers finish and the results list the roster in order, AI finish ticks are distinct and reproduce, and RETRY / RESTART / NEXT each start a six-car race. All gates are green. Minor issues: an 8-row stage fixture still overflows on the phone, the sim/results changes go beyond the expected file list, and one test has a stray mock. The gate race screenshots still show 2 cars because of the protected driver, which the plan audit already flagged.

check.summary: review.md lists three verified fixes. All three match the diff. R1-1 reworks the results layout: the stripe becomes a full-width top band, the table and buttons move to a right column, and rows get a tighter gap and smaller type, all through tokens. The 844×390 podium screenshot shows six rows and both buttons fitting. R2-2 moves the menuTrack assignment after raceDrivers/createWorld and adds a regression test. R3-1 merges the two duplicated playerInputs helpers into tests/game/helpers.ts on top of the existing botsFor. Test counts match gates.md (600/600). I can't confirm everything: raceDrivers' throw behaviour, the botsFor line number and the pre-fix pixel positions aren't in the inputs. The review is also silent on two things my blind scores flagged: the 8-row long-list stage still overflows, and src/sim/world.ts adds curved grid slots beyond the expected files. No new agent rules and no planted instructions found.
